**PotentialWarp 1.0.0**, the first release.

A tempo-locked mangler for your MPC, in the spirit of Gross Beat: 16 one-tap patterns of stutters, half speed, tape stops, spinbacks, reverses and gates, locked to your beat. See the [README](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwarp#readme) for everything it does and its limitations.

**Download** `PotentialWarp-1.0.0-mpc-armv7.zip` below for Gen1 (32-bit) MPCs with the community plugin set-up on MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. On **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, use the `-akai-vst2.zip` instead (see the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwarp/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md)).

Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome. [Open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialwarp/issues/new/choose).
